instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Forge is a micro-NGO focused on implementing sustainable water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) programs across 6 sub-Saharan African countries. The organization manages significant donor funds but lacks formalized operational SOPs or dedicated technology infrastructure to scale its impact efficiently.
answers.pastInitiatives: The organization has operated primarily through ad-hoc problem-solving driven by immediate field needs, treating unexpected operational challenges as opportunities for localized solutions. There is no formal ideation pipeline, structured experimentation framework, or dedicated budget allocated specifically for R&D or market exploration.
answers.strategicGoals: Growth is our existential mandate; the organization must significantly increase its scale and efficiency to secure long-term funding viability. This requires developing scalable, high-impact solutions that can justify larger institutional grants and potentially establish sustainable revenue streams.
answers.additionalContext: A new CEO has signaled a mandatory pivot towards digital transformation and innovation, creating significant internal tension between the founder's rapid, informal operational style and the need for structured growth initiatives.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Acquisition of a Regional Tech Platform
opportunities.rationale: Given the extreme lack of internal technical expertise and digital maturity (1), acquiring or heavily partnering with an established localized tech firm could instantly provide scalable monitoring capabilities. This radical move bypasses years of slow in-house development.

first_actions: Identify 5 key regional SaaS providers offering water point monitoring solutions.
Conduct preliminary due diligence focusing on integration ease and existing donor alignment.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Consultant fees for M&A/Partnership legal review ($10k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Signature MOU with a target platform by Month 4.
milestones: Week 3: Target list finalized and initial outreach complete.
Month 2: Finalize legal terms for pilot partnership.

opportunities.title: Standardization of Field Feedback Loops
opportunities.rationale: Implementing a simple, structured digital feedback mechanism (even low-cost SMS/app form) will help capture systematic customer data for future strategy development. This incremental step addresses the 'process' barrier directly.

first_actions: Develop a standardized 3-question mobile survey template.
Pilot deployment with one field team in two countries.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Contract for basic low-code app development ($5k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 40% survey completion rate among pilot teams.
milestones: Month 2: Pilot launch and initial data collection.
Month 4: Full rollout plan based on pilot results.

opportunities.title: Diversification into Impact-as-a-Service (IaaS)
opportunities.rationale: Instead of purely relying on grants, Forge could package its successful monitoring tech and data insights as a service offering for other NGOs or government bodies. This creates a new revenue stream that aligns with the 'growth' mandate.

first_actions: Create a simplified pitch deck demonstrating ROI of monitoring services.
Engage an external business development consultant specializing in impact financing.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure one paid pilot contract or service agreement by Month 6.
milestones: Month 3: Create service catalog and pricing model.

next_steps.action: Establish a cross-functional 'Innovation Sandbox' team (Founder + 1 hired Tech Advisor).
Draft and socialize a three-year strategic roadmap prioritizing either platform acquisition or IaaS service development.

key_weaknesses: Extreme lack of formal innovation process, leading to reactive rather than proactive growth strategies.
Critical dependency on the founder for all technical decision-making and execution bandwidth is unsustainable for scaling.
No formalized customer feedback loop, making strategic bets based purely on internal assumptions rather than external validation.
High regulatory burden combined with low digital maturity makes adopting new technologies extremely risky without specialized expertise.
